review.brief: Review tier 1 of RM38 (ticket MAG-12) in internal/analytics, diff main...HEAD, four commits e263711/33d3ea6/b178acd/e3cd565. Validate: (1) module-boundary compliance - VehicleStatus is analytics-owned and never is/embeds telemetry.Snapshot; the only out-of-module edits are two test-fake stubs the leader added (internal/app/processor_test.go, internal/gateway/handlers/history_test.go). (2) Every DB object matches the design the OWNER confirmed at the gate: eight nullable columns, no DEFAULT, no backfill, plus idx_vehicle_metrics_latest (account_id, tesla_id, metric_date DESC) - any mismatch is a blocker finding. (3) design D3 - all eight fields populated in BOTH deriveVehicleMetrics branches, never gated behind prev == nil. (4) The integration tests assert the expectations design.md's Test Contract authored up front (Fixtures RM38-A/B/C), not whatever the implementation happens to produce. Scrutinise the seedSnapshot helper change here. (5) Performance-Profile (read-heavy) compliance. (6) spec/tasks coverage and doc-pack conventions, incl. AGENTS.md and root README.md. (7) Anti-gaming: no weakened acceptance criteria, no self-approved statuses, tasks append-only. SIGNAL PROVENANCE: assistant-run and clean - go build ./..., go vet ./..., make build, make vet, make bins, make migration-guard. USER-REPORTED - the OWNER ran 'make test' and reported it passed; the assistant never ran the suite. make boundary-guard fails, but it fails on main too (gateway's production telemetry imports, which RM38 tier 2 removes) - pre-existing, not this tier's defect. Judge test quality by READING the tests; do not run the suite.

decisions.why: Removes the incremental sort the all-ascending unique index forces on the mixed-direction ORDER BY; owner accepted the extra write per upsert

decisions.decision: Applied the index revision as a leader edit to design/tasks/proposal instead of re-dispatching the worker
decisions.why: Bounded single-item edit; a re-dispatch re-reads the full doc pack, costing far more than the change

decisions.decision: Worker's design D3 accepted: all 8 columns populated in BOTH Recalculate branches, unlike the five _calc columns
decisions.why: They are raw per-day observations, not deltas; gating them would blank the badges on a vehicle's first tracked day

decisions.decision: Batch the 7 dependency waves into 3 worker dispatches (W1+W2, W3, W4+W5+6.1); 6.2 and W7 stay with the leader
decisions.why: W1->W2->W3 is a strict serial chain in one module; each extra dispatch re-reads the whole doc pack for no isolation gain
